title: Seven-eighths guarantee for Max-3SAT
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set of Boolean variables, and consider a nonempty finite multiset of clauses, each containing three literals on pairwise distinct variables, where each literal is either a variable or its negation. Assume every variable in $V$ occurs in some clause. The maximum, over all Boolean assignments to $V$, of the fraction of clauses satisfied, counted with multiplicity, is at least $7/8$.
hypotheses_covered: the instance uses Boolean variables and Boolean assignments
each constraint is a three-literal disjunction
the three variables in each clause are pairwise distinct
every variable occurs in some constraint
